competitive_position.basis: Stated in the 10-K Item 1A Risk Factors.
competitive_position.claim: Uniti is subject to FCC and state regulatory commissions that limit pricing flexibility for regulated voice and high-speed internet products and impose carrier-of-last-resort obligations, while cable competitors are generally subject to less stringent regulations and their rates are not subject to regulation.
quotes: We are subject to various forms of regulation from the regulatory commissions in each state where our service territory is located, as well as from the FCC.

Consumer areas also may be subject to "carrier of last resort" obligations, which generally obligate the company to provide basic voice services to any person within our service area regardless of the profitability of the customer. Competitors in these areas are not subject to such requirements.

competitive_position.basis: Stated in the 10-K Item 1A Risk Factors.

material_events.claim: Uniti Group Inc. completed its merger with Windstream, combining the two companies into a single entity with approximately 240,000 fiber route miles across 47 states and more than 1.0 million customers.
quotes: On August 1, 2025, pursuant to the previously announced Agreement and Plan of Merger, dated as of May 3, 2024 (as amended) (the "Merger Agreement"), by and between Old Uniti, Windstream, the Company, New Uniti HoldCo LP and New Windstream Merger Sub, LLC, an indirect wholly owned subsidiary of Windstream ("Merger Sub"), Old Uniti and Windstream completed the following transactions: (a) Windstream merged with and into the Company (at such time, a direct wholly owned subsidiary of Windstream named Windstream Parent, Inc.), with the Company surviving the merger as the ultimate parent company of the combined company (the "Internal Reorg Merger"), and (b) Merger Sub merged with and into Old Uniti (the "Merger"), with Old Uniti surviving the Merger as an indirect wholly owned subsidiary of the Company.
Following the consummation of the Merger, the Company was renamed Uniti Group Inc., Old Uniti ceased to be a REIT, and the Company does not qualify to be a REIT.

quotes: On January 30, 2026, Kinetic ABS Issuer LLC (the "Kinetic ABS Issuer"), an indirect, bankruptcy-remote subsidiary of the Company, completed a private offering of $960.1 million aggregate principal amount of secured fiber network revenue term notes, consisting of $677.7 million 5.219% Series 2026-1, Class A-2 term notes, $113.0 million 5.561% Series 2026-1, Class B term notes and $169.4 million 7.653% Series 2026-1, Class C term notes (collectively, the "Kinetic ABS Term Notes"), each with an anticipated repayment date in February 2031.

material_events.basis: Stated in the 10-K MD&A (P3) and 10-K Risk Factors (P2).
material_events.claim: Uniti subsidiaries completed a private offering of $1.0 billion of 8.625% Senior Notes due 2032, with proceeds used to repay the $500.0 million senior secured first lien term loan facility due 2031 and for general corporate purposes.
quotes: On February 4, 2026, Uniti Services, Uniti Group Finance 2019 Inc., Uniti Fiber Holdings Inc. and CSL Capital, LLC (together, the "2026 Unsecured Notes Issuers"), each a subsidiary of the Company, completed a private offering of $1.0 billion aggregate principal amount of 8.625% Senior Notes due 2032 (the "2026 Unsecured Notes").

in the first quarter of 2026, we completed refinancing transactions which included the issuance of $1.0 billion of 8.625% secured notes. Net proceeds from the debt issuance were used to repay the $500.0 million senior secured first lien term loan facility due 2031 and for general corporate purposes, including the repayment of outstanding debt.

material_events.basis: Stated in the 8-K filed July 20, 2026 (P10) and the Q2 2026 earnings release (P6).
material_events.claim: Kinetic ABS Issuer LLC completed its second fiber-to-the-home securitization, issuing $1,140,710,000 of Series 2026-2 secured fiber network revenue term notes with an anticipated repayment date in June 2033, bringing total outstanding revenue term notes to $2,100,810,000.
quotes: On July 15, 2026, Kinetic ABS Issuer LLC (the "Issuer"), an indirect, bankruptcy-remote subsidiary of Uniti Group Inc. (the "Company"), completed a private offering of $1,140,710,000 aggregate principal amount of secured fiber network revenue term notes, consisting of $805,210,000 5.834% Series 2026-2, Class A-2 term notes, $134,200,000 6.224% Series 2026-2, Class B term notes and $201,300,000 7.536% Series 2026-2, Class C term notes (collectively, the "Series 2026-2 Term Notes"), each with an anticipated repayment date (the "Term ARD") in June of 2033.

As of the closing of the transactions on July 15, 2026, the Issuer has $2,100,810,000 aggregate principal amount of revenue term notes outstanding, $0 principal amount of variable funding notes outstanding and $0 principal amount of liquidity funding notes outstanding.

material_events.basis: Stated in 8-Ks filed July 27 (P9), August 4 (P8), and August 24 (P7).
material_events.claim: Uniti announced a term loan prepayment offer of up to $167,791,000 on its senior secured term loan due 2032 and concurrent asset sale offers to purchase up to $332,209,000 (later increased to $480,236,000) of 4.750% Senior Secured Notes due 2028 and 7.500% Senior Secured Notes due 2033, funded by proceeds from the July 15 Kinetic ABS offering; the offers were completed with $479,054,000 of 2028 Notes and $1,182,000 of 2033 Notes accepted for purchase, settling August 24, 2026.
quotes: On July 23, 2026, Uniti Services LLC ("Uniti Services") issued a prepayment notice to the lenders of its senior secured term loan due 2032 (the "Term Loan") to prepay up to $167,791,000 principal amount (the "Term Loan Prepayment Amount") of Term Loan on July 30, 2026 (the "Term Loan Prepayment Offer").

The Issuers increased the size of the Asset Sale Offers from $332,209,000 to $480,236,000 aggregate principal amount of Notes following the completion of Uniti Services' offer to prepay up to $167,791,000 principal amount of outstanding term loan due 2032, in which the lenders elected to tender $19.8 million of term loan for prepayment.
On August 21, 2026, the Issuers accepted for purchase $479,054,000 aggregate principal amount of the 2028 Notes and $1,182,000 aggregate principal amount of the 2033 Notes.

quotes: Our level of indebtedness could materially and adversely affect our financial position, including reducing funds available for other business purposes and reducing our operational flexibility.

risks.basis: Stated in P1 and P2 risk factors; counter-evidence from P6 earnings release highlights.
risks.claim: Intense and growing competition from cable, fixed wireless, satellite, and fiber overbuilders—including new entrants funded by RDOF and BEAD broadband programs—could erode Uniti's consumer and business market share, forcing price reductions or increased marketing spend that compresses margins.
quotes: We face intense competitive pressures in our markets, including, but not limited to, competition from wireless companies, cable television companies, fixed wireless and satellite companies, and electric cooperatives in consumer service areas and other communications carriers or providers in business markets.

While approximately 20% of households in our footprint have no high-speed wireline competitor, the emergence of wireless home internet providers means there are very few locations in our footprint without meaningful competition.

Competition in the consumer markets could also increase as awards are determined under various state and federal broadband funding programs, including the Infrastructure Investment and Jobs Act, via the Broadband Equity Access and Deployment Program ("BEAD"), by states and municipalities, and state specific funding programs.

risks.basis: Stated in P2 risk factors as a general ongoing condition; no specific adverse event is reported in the evidence.
risks.claim: FCC and state regulatory commissions limit Uniti's pricing flexibility for regulated voice and high-speed internet products, impose carrier-of-last-resort obligations, and the company's revenue depends on continued participation in USF, RDOF, and other government broadband programs; loss of eligibility or adverse regulatory change could materially reduce revenue.
quotes: We are subject to various forms of regulation from the FCC and state regulatory commissions, which limit pricing flexibility for regulated voice and high-speed internet products, subject us to service quality, service reporting and other obligations and expose us to the reduction of revenue from changes to the USF, the inter-carrier compensation system, or access to interconnection with competitors' facilities.
If we are prohibited from participating in government programs, results of operations could be materially and adversely affected.

Consumer areas also may be subject to "carrier of last resort" obligations, which generally obligate the company to provide basic voice services to any person within our service area regardless of the profitability of the customer.

risks.basis: Stated in P2 risk factors; balance sheet figure from F1; 2023 impairment from P3.
risks.claim: Uniti carries $1,158.5 million of goodwill (as of June 30, 2026) that could be impaired if negative industry trends, changes in fair value assumptions, or underperformance relative to acquisition cost materialize, which would reduce reported earnings and equity.
quotes: At December 31, 2025, we had $1,158.3 million of goodwill on our consolidated balance sheet.

Although we assess potential impairment of its goodwill on an annual basis, negative industry or economic trends and/or any changes in key assumptions regarding our fair value may cause us to perform an interim analysis of goodwill and to report an impairment charge in the future, which could have a significant adverse impact on our reported earnings.

risks.basis: Stated in P2 risk factors as a general risk; no specific incident is reported in any evidence item.
risks.claim: Cybersecurity attacks or system failures could disrupt Uniti's network operations, expose customer and employee data, trigger regulatory penalties, and require significant remediation costs, with risks elevated by the increasing sophistication of AI-enabled threats.
quotes: Cybersecurity incidents could have a material adverse effect on our business, results of operations and financial condition.

As cybersecurity threats become increasingly sophisticated and severe, particularly with the use of Artificial Intelligence ("AI") and machine learning by cybercriminals, the proliferation of organized cybercrime groups, hackers, terrorists, and other external parties, including foreign and state-supported actors, the increasing public awareness of the importance of safeguarding personal information, and the growing volume of legislation adopted or being considered regarding data privacy and cybersecurity, cybersecurity-related risks have increased, and will continue to increase.
